One trusted data foundation for every payer decision.
Health Chain delivers a unified, FHIR-Native Health Data Management Platform that provides full CMS compliance and gives every team access to complete, trusted member data where and when it matters most.
Get Started
Learn More
Industry Memberships & Recognition
CMS Compliant
NCQA Certified
FHIR R4 Ready
HL7 Member
Missing time-sensitive follow up windows, increasing open care gaps
Subpar data quality dragging down HEDIS & Star Rating Performance
Missed Risk Revenue with underreported or inaccurate diagnoses
Fragmented healthcare data is holding you back.
Healthcare is producing more data than ever, yet most payers still lack a complete view of their members, providers, and business.
The costs?
Rising administrative costs and missed reimbursement due to poor data quality
Growing exposure to CMS mandates that become more complex with every rule cycle
Critical decisions made with incomplete member data
Slower innovation, unmanaged utilization, and overburdened teams
Patients who don’t receive the care they need, when they need it
Health data management isn’t optional anymore.  The future belongs to payers who can activate data in real time across every team, every workflow, and every stakeholder.
The Only FHIR-Native Health Data Management Platform
Complete
Ingest, normalize, and unify clinical, claims, provider, and administrative data on a single FHIR-native foundation, eliminating fragmented systems and manual data aggregation.
Trusted
Data is continuously validated, governed, and standardized to support CMS mandates, NCQA requirements, audits, and business-critical reporting.
Available
One source of truth accessible across utilization management, care management, quality, compliance, and analytics teams, without custom integrations.
Actionable
Data is immediately ready for automation, intelligence, and analytics, enabling faster decisions and real operational and financial impact.
Ready to transform your healthcare data?
Get Started
The Health Chain Advantage
01
Complete Member Data
Unified clinical, claims, provider, and administrative data in one FHIR-standardized record.
02
End-to-End CMS  Compliance
All CMS-0057-F mandated FHIR APIs activated, secured, and continuously maintained.
03
Faster, Smarter  Utilization Management
Enables earlier, informed care decisions so members get the right treatment in the right setting before higher-cost care is needed.
04
Better HEDIS & Star  rating performance
Real time insights that close gaps in care and lift quality scores across populations.
05
Superior Data  Quality
AI-driven reconciliation, enrichment, and validation powered by Centaur™.
06
Lower Total Cost of  Ownership
One scalable platform that replaces fragmented systems and reduces operational spend.

let’s talk
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Centaur Data Platform
admin
2026-01-20T14:24:29+00:00
 
 
Breaking Down Data Barriers. Enabling Better Healthcare.
Access Data That Connects, Powers, & Transforms Healthcare
Data is scattered across systems, locked in silos, and often out of reach when it’s needed most. Centaur™ Data Platform changes that by providing a unified, scalable platform to seamlessly ingest, normalize, and curate healthcare data from every source—FHIR or non-FHIR—into a single, Health Data Management Platform.
Schedule A Demo
What’s Part of Centaur™?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified Access to Every Data Source
Healthcare data comes in all shapes and sizes—structured, unstructured, clinical, financial, and more. Centaur™’s comprehensive source data connectors automatically ingest real-time data from a wide array of sources, including EHRs, core administrative processing tools, labs, and external systems, creating a single, integrated view of each member’s data.
See how Source Data Connectors unlocks all your data
 
Perfecting Patient Identification Across Systems
Mismatched patient records are costly. Centaur™’s Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) ensures every patient’s identity is accurately matched and linked across multiple data sources, providing a more complete and accurate picture of each patient, enabling more personalized care journeys.
Learn how EMPI improves data integrity
 
Turning Raw Data into Actionable Insights
Data is only as good as its ability to drive outcomes. Centaur™’s powerful data processing engine transforms raw healthcare data into clean, usable insights, performing everything from data enrichment to complex transformations with speed and efficiency. Whether it’s coordinating care or better managing chronic conditions, Centaur™ accelerates data’s time to value.
Discover how our data processing powers results
 
Streamlining Data Transformation with Precision
Data interoperability shouldn’t be a roadblock to better care. Centaur™’s HL7 Engine streamlines the transformation and translation of HL7 messages into standardized formats such as FHIR, making each message accessible across the care continuum in real-time. With Centaur™, healthcare data flows effortlessly—compliant, consistent, and ready for action.
See how the HL7 Engine powers interoperability
 
Real-Time Data Confidence
In healthcare, the stakes are high, and data accuracy is critical. Centaur™’s Data Observability tools give organizations full visibility into the health of their data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation, ensuring high-quality, reliable data every time. With real-time monitoring and alerts, healthcare organizations can confidently trust the data they use to make critical decisions.
Explore Data Observability 
 
One Platform for All Interoperability Needs
HDIG centralizes API ecosystems. From managing FHIR APIs to providing a developer portal with a robust sandbox environment and consent management it offers a streamlined experience for API deployment, management, access and monitoring. The platform seamlessly integrates with critical systems such as IDAM tools and API Gateways.
See how Core Interoperability Platform simplifies data exchange 
 
APIs That Power Interoperability
HDIG’s comprehensive FHIR API suite is more than just compliant—it’s future-proof. Enable seamless patient data sharing, streamline prior authorizations, and enhance provider access with real-time, secure APIs. Whether it’s the Patient Access API, Prior Authorization API, Provider Access API or Payer-to-Payer API, HDIG a sustainable ecosystem when adhering to regulatory demands.
Be CMS-ready today and innovation-ready tomorrow 
 
Instantly Turn FHIR Data into Business-Ready Insights
Healthcare data holds answers. HDIG’s Common Data Model built on USCDI & FHIR provides industry-standardized data, while the power of SQL on FHIR allows FHIR data to be queried as easily as relational tables. Materialized views deliver real-time insights, ensuring teams can make informed decisions faster from out-of-the-box data marts.
From raw data to refined insights – see the difference
 
Visibility That Drives Confidence
Don’t just meet compliance-exceed it. HDIG provides actionable insights into API usage and performance, complete with CMS-mandated reporting. With real-time analytics, gain visibility that powers better decisions and boosts operational confidence.
Know your APIs. Trust your data 
 
Interoperability Gaps and Compliance Pressures
Regulations like the CMS Interoperability mandates require Providers to facilitate seamless data exchange, but legacy systems and limited FHIR adoption create barriers. Non-compliance can lead to financial penalties, reduced reimbursements and less collaboration.
 
 
 
 Page 1 of 2
 
1
2
 
 
 
 
Ready to Transform Healthcare Data?
Centaur™ Data Platform is more than just an ETL tool—it’s a game-changer for healthcare organizations. With its out-of-the-box data ingestion pipelines and powerful data transformation capabilities, Centaur™ accelerates data accessibility and time-to-value. Data is no longer fragmented or siloed, but accessible, actionable, and ready to drive meaningful impact in healthcare.
Request a Demo and Experience the Transformation
